tool_role: deterministic preparation helper; no face detection, landmarks, segmentation or neural face parsing

source.provenance: same 512 RGB Mona Lisa crop reused byte-exact from the prior LivePortrait example; the original painting is public domain; not a newly generated portrait
source.role: output canvas for the original paste-back; not modified or copied by this helper

bbox_origin: manual operator-designated box, not a detector result

crop.storage: 8-bit RGB PNG; OpenCV loads it as BGR, which original VAE.get_latents_for_unet expects for ndarray input

mask.purpose: declared manual lower-half blending mask for original get_image_blending; not neural face parsing

rule.rows_160_171: np.rint(np.linspace(0, 255, 12)) per row, constant across columns

mask.channels: three identical channels (original myutil.get_image_blending converts BGR to gray)

upper_half_masked_face.operation: face256 copy with rows 128..255 set to 0, mirroring the half mask in original VAE.preprocess_img(half_mask=True)
upper_half_masked_face.role: visual check of the deterministic input to the masked-latent path; not a model output
